design.summary: Arduino desk arm: 3 DOF + claw, 280 mm reach, 20 g payload, 0.87 kg, $51 of parts

uses: controller (USB serial commands, I2C to the servo driver)

performance.servos: TowerPro SG90 micro servo / TowerPro MG996R standard servo

assumptions: Joint limits trimmed to the collision-free range found by exact solid sweeps: claw [-0.60, 0.35] -> [0.00, 0.29].
each joint runs on its servo's own output bearing (no extra bearings), as in MeArm-class kits: links are kept short so the servo holds them continuously
prices are typical single-unit marketplace prices and vary by seller

notes: Mains side: IEC inlet to the supply's AC terminals with insulated spades and ferrules, earth wired first, case closed before plugging in. Have it checked if you are not qualified to wire mains.
The Uno runs from its USB cable (it takes serial commands from the PC), the servos from the adapter; the two grounds join at the I2C lead.
